usage: 牛肉腸粉 (beef rice noodle roll) is a noun and refers to a specific type of dim sum dish.
You can use 牛肉腸粉 as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我想食牛肉腸粉' (I want to eat beef rice noodle roll).
When ordering in a restaurant, you can say '請俾我一份牛肉腸粉' (Please give me one beef rice noodle roll).
牛肉腸粉 can be modified by adjectives to describe taste or style, such as '好味嘅牛肉腸粉' (delicious beef rice noodle roll).
This noun is commonly used in casual conversation about meals, especially breakfast or brunch.
